chapter: Brass bands, country bands and Alamo
title: Dance bands in Slidell, Bogalusa and country towns
summary: Asked about bands outside New Orleans, Foster mentions Slidell, King Gordy's band in Bogalusa, and the only clarinetist he knew over the lake.
